verdict.rationale: A public agency site with extensive online guidance could reasonably publish llms.txt or agent-oriented docs, so the axis applies. Probes found no such resources: llms.txt, markdown doc variants and OpenAPI paths all returned 404. The documentation pages describe only human-facing web services (UTR, UTS, QuickFile).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
